# cloudaxion_firewall_attachment (Resource)

Applies a `cloudaxion_firewall` to a `cloudaxion_vm`.

Attachment is an operation in the API, not an object, so this resource carries a synthetic `id` of `firewall_id:vm_id`. Both sides stay independently managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudaxion_firewall_attachment" "control_plane" {
  firewall_id = cloudaxion_firewall.control_plane.id
  vm_id       = cloudaxion_vm.node.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_id` (String) UUID of the firewall to apply.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the virtual machine to apply it to.

### Optional

- `location` (String) Location slug. Defaults to the provider's `location`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier, `firewall_id:vm_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudaxion_firewall_attachment.control_plane tun01/1449c7e2-0f8f-42df-90d6-c1f726fbb55b:6c772f89-d00c-4d41-8acd-0202599c4ed3
```
